Required (minimal) network egress: outbound HTTPS to api.redwood.ai (443) and S3 endpoints if you plan to use object-backed inputs.
KMS: we support bring-your-own-key (AWS KMS / GCP KMS) and can scope key access patterns during the call.
> For retention and SOC2 questions — I’ll attach the short SOC2 summary and the retention table. Jenna/Sam, if you can confirm which data types you expect to process, I’ll flag anything that requires an enterprise plan.

Availability: 8/17 10:30am EDT works for me (I’ll join remotely from APAC; timezone is fine). I’ll drop a proposed invite with the SE-runbook and a ics attached.
